items.title: Do Time-Series Foundation Models Forecast Index-Futures Returns? A Preregistered Evaluation of Models, Metrics, and Input Representations
items.claim: Zero-shot foundation models produce no incremental forecasting skill over no-change for intraday equity index futures.

items.title: Inside the Trading Loop: Markets, Models, and Moves with LLM Agents
items.claim: LLM-analyst paper trading returned 34.5 percent versus 14.4 percent for SPY over the same period.

items.title: This Machine Picks Stocks
items.claim: Decoupling prediction from expected-value trade selection produced positive short-term equity returns in out-of-sample backtests.

items.title: Headline AI Numbers Hide Disagreement: Grader Refusal, Contested Labels and Lost Verdicts in AI Safety and Financial Evaluation
items.claim: Headline AI safety scores mask grader disagreement, with attack success estimates ranging from 9.8 to 49.0 percent.

items.title: Retrospective Analysis of Team-Following Trading Profitability in Pumpfun Meme Coins Using Funding Networks
items.claim: Known-token-team following generated retrospective returns above one SOL in eight Pumpfun windows, conditional on hindsight selection.

items.title: FinCutBench: A Continually Updated Benchmark for Measuring the Temporal Boundaries of LLM Financial Knowledge
items.claim: FinCut Boundary dates vary across models, and some models show clear relative declines in U.S. financial recall after the boundary.
